notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
[b]New features added to the demo based on feedback[/b]

- Added a timer to screen and increased the time to 10 minutes
- Added a secondary control scheme where WASD is forward based on camera position. Press L at any time in game to switch

[b]Things we are still working on[/b]

- Changing camera angles/ Better camera positions
- Slowing down the mouse/Mouse options

notes.title: Thank You and Updates
notes.content:
Thank you all for playing the demo and leaving advice for improving the game. Though the game will remain in the fixed camera genre we are working on the following suggestions to make it more fluid for everyone:
1. Slowing down character turning
2. Different control scheme and/or the option to switch tank styles
3. On screen countdown timer so death isn't so much of a surprise
4. Camera switching/camera angle improvements.
Again thank you all for giving our little game here a chance and look forward to a new demo prior to release.
